title: paddhu-sms-export, version 1
description: What Ping hands to Paddhu Pusthakam. Unknown fields MUST be ignored by the reader (both directions stay compatible).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds. Sent by the date-range file and the long-press path only.

address.description: the raw sender, exactly as received (never normalised)

body.description: the full text, multipart parts joined in order, never altered

brand.description: optional: display name of the sender brand, e.g. Axis Bank

brandKey.description: optional: stable key of the brand logo, e.g. axisbank

kind.description: optional: what Ping thinks the message is; a fixed deposit wins when both patterns match

category.description: optional: Ping's category of the sender's conversation
